adaptations: Two 40 GB A100 GPUs rather than upstream example one 80 GB H100; same BF16 weights and native inference code
Concurrency reduced to one request for pilot memory use
Removed unused decord package; dense path decodes using native PyAV implementation
Runtime PATH and compiler setup changed to permit kernel compilation; no upstream prompt or postprocessing edits

timing_caveat.example: R001 has 48 native segments over 14 seconds; 46 last less than 0.5 seconds
timing_caveat.interpretation: Rapid switching is reproducible in official nearest-group stitching across overlapping windows; it does not establish independent frame-level model judgments

limitations: Genuine model output does not establish annotation accuracy
No bitwise comparison against the upstream H100 hardware configuration has been performed
Only dense Rewarder was run; TempSeg and Captioner were not run
Scores and rationales use future context and are offline annotations
No human video correctness assessment or training-label adapter has been completed
